DECK.name: Deckers Outdoor

NKE.name: Nike
sbc: Plan: NIKE Stock Incentive Plan (up to 798 million previously unissued Class B shares). Awards: stock options, SARs, restricted stock, RSUs and PSUs; granted generally once a year.
Substantially all awards vest ratably over 4 years. Options expire after 10 years and are priced at no less than fair market value on the grant date.
Expense FY2025 / FY2024 / FY2023 ($M): options and SARs 292 / 336 / 311; ESPP 69 / 69 / 72; restricted stock and RSUs 348 / 399 / 372; total 709 / 804 / 755.
Unrecognized at May 31, 2025: $400M for options (2.4-year weighted period) and $631M for restricted stock and RSUs (2.5 years).
75.1M options outstanding at a weighted $97.99 exercise price. FY2025 grants: 13.3M options at $83.20, grant-date fair value $25.90.
ESPP: employees bought 3.6M, 3.1M and 3.0M shares in FY2025, FY2024 and FY2023 at 85% of the lower of start or end-of-period market price.
NKE.src: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2025

PYPL.name: PayPal
sbc: Plan: Amended and Restated 2015 Equity Incentive Award Plan. Awards: RSUs, restricted stock, PBRSUs, options, deferred stock units. About 75M shares authorized and 45M available at Dec 31, 2025.
RSUs granted since 2022 vest over 3 years (33% after year one, then quarterly). PBRSUs are earned over 1-3 year performance periods and pay 0-200% of target.

Expense 2025 / 2024 / 2023 ($M): 1,084 / 1,293 / 1,530 (2024 includes $100M restructuring). 2025 by function: technology and development 489, general and administrative 266, customer support 204, sales and marketing 125. A further $134M was capitalized in 2025.
Unrecognized: about $1.4B at Dec 31, 2025, over a weighted 1.87 years.
Awards 2025: 22.3M RSU/PBRSU/restricted units granted ($70.92); 15.9M vested; 31.8M outstanding at year end. Intrinsic value vested: $1.1B in 2025.
ESPP: 2.6M shares bought in 2025 at an average $45.85.
PYPL.src: Form 10-K for the year ended Dec 31, 2025

ADSK.name: Autodesk
sbc: Awards: RSUs (vest over 1-4 years), PSUs (revenue, non-GAAP operating income less SBC and relative TSR criteria; up to one-third can vest after each of years one to three) and an ESPP (up to 15% of pay at 85% of the lower of offering-date or exercise-date price).
Expense FY2026 / FY2025 / FY2024 ($M): 788 / 686 / 703. By plan FY2026: RSUs 596, PSUs 77, ESPP 115. By line FY2026: R&D 339, marketing and sales 284, G&A 107, cost of revenue 58.
Unvested restricted stock FY2026: 5,188K at start, granted 2,860K ($265.58), vested 3,048K, canceled 529K, 4,477K at Jan 31, 2026 ($255.39).
Unrecognized at Jan 31, 2026: RSUs $737M (1.80 years), PSUs $24M (1.14 years).
Repurchases: FY2026 about 5M shares at $290.38; FY2025 3M at $278.86; FY2024 4M at $201.54. $2.48B left on the Nov 2022 program and $5B on the Nov 2024 program (no expiry).
ADSK.src: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2026

PRKA.name: Parks! America
sbc: Parks! America (animal safari parks in Georgia, Missouri and Texas). Taken to be the PRKA you meant (ticker PRKA, CIK 1297937); ParkerVision trades as PRKR.
No stock options have ever been granted. The 2005 Stock Option and Award Plan reserves 5,000,000 shares but has not been approved by stockholders and no awards have been made under it.

Compensation is paid in shares: FY2024 expense $57,500 (209,088 shares issued to directors); FY2023 $131,667 (162,500 director shares plus 128,205 shares to the CEO under his employment agreement, equity statement value $115,000).

Shares outstanding 75,726,851 at Sep 29, 2024 and 75,517,763 at Oct 1, 2023. The FY2024 10-K reports no repurchases; the company has since announced a share repurchase program, which the live tables pick up once it shows in a filing.
PRKA.src: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended Sep 29, 2024
